ConnectionStrings._comment: Set via env var ConnectionStrings__Default in production (systemd). Example: server=localhost;port=3306;database=iamhakim;user=iamhakim;password=...

ClientIdentity._comment: Raw IP addresses are never stored. The API stores only a salted SHA-256 hash for anti-abuse limits. Set IpHashSalt via env var Security__ClientIdentity__IpHashSalt in production.

Turnstile._comment: Cloudflare Turnstile. Set Enabled=true and pass SiteKey/SecretKey via environment variables in production.

Booking._comment: Set Mode to 'live' and enable a provider below to use real calendars.

Meeting._comment: Optional phone number shown in phone-call confirmation e-mails and calendar events.

AntiSpam._comment: Email + salted-IP anti-abuse protection. Raw IP addresses are not stored.

BookingRetention._comment: Enforces the retention promise in the privacy policy. RetentionDays = how long after a meeting EndUtc a booking row is kept.

Mail._comment: Set Enabled=true in production and pass Mail__ResendApiKey via environment variable / secret store.
